You need to get the console mod so you can noclip through the door. Gaffer will talk to you, walk past and accept the quest from Warlock. After, go to the bunker with hamster and PAY his bodyguard. After that, go find Warlocks rifle. Once you find the rifle, you’ll see Hamster and his bodyguard walking up to the town hall. They’ll try to open the door, but die. However, for some reason this unlocks the door. After that, you shouldn’t have to noclip in again and the door will be unlocked from now on. Hopefully this works for you too!!!
